title: An element annihilating the first Ext argument acts trivially on Ext
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ and $B$ be $R$-modules, and let $x\in R$ satisfy $xA=0$. For every integer $i\ge0$, multiplication by $x$ on $B$ induces the zero endomorphism of $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(A,B)$, with Ext as in [def-pc-ext].
